rows.note: Use 刺耳 when a sound is harsh or unpleasant to hear.

example.english: The sound of this drill is really jarring.
example.traditional: 呢把電鑽聲真係好刺耳。
example.jyutping: ne1 baa2 din6 zyun3 seng1 zan1 hai6 hou2 ci3 ji5

rows.note: Use 唔協調 when colours, styles, or parts clash or do not match.

example.english: Her orange jacket and purple trousers are really jarring.
example.traditional: 佢件橙色外套同條紫色褲好唔協調。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin6 caang2 sik1 ngoi6 tou3 tung4 tiu4 zi2 sik1 fu3 hou2 m4 hip3 tiu4

rows.note: Use 格格不入 when something is conspicuously out of place in its surroundings.

example.english: Putting a vending machine in the old-fashioned lobby seems jarring.
example.traditional: 古色古香嘅大堂入面擺部自動販賣機，顯得格格不入。
example.jyutping: gu2 sik1 gu2 hoeng1 ge3 daai6 tong4 jap6 min6 baai2 bou6 zi6 dung6 faan3 maai6 gei1 hin2 dak1 gaak3 gaak3 bat1 jap6
